INSERT INTO FCR_MST (FTA_CODE, SALES_NO, SALES_SEQ, PRODUCT_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, HS_CODE, STANDARD, AMOUNT, NET_COST_AMOUNT, EXWORK_AMOUNT, FOB_AMOUNT, INAREA_AMOUNT, OUTAREA_AMOUNT, SP_COO_YN, WO_COO_YN, PRODUCT_UNIT, PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE, PROD_DIVISION_CODE, IM_APPLY_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY, DECISION_YN) VALUES
(#{row.ftaCode}, #{row.salesNo}, #{row.salesSeq}, #{row.productCode}, #{row.divisionCode}, #{row.companyCode}, #{row.hsCode}, #{row.standard}, #{row.amount}, #{row.netCostAmount}, #{row.exworkAmount}, #{row.fobAmount}, 0, 0, #{row.spCooYn}, #{row.woCooYn}, #{row.productUnit}, #{row.productAssetsType}, #{row.prodDivisionCode}, #{row.imApplyYn}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'CREATE_FCR', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'CREATE_FCR', 'Y')

INSERT INTO FCR_DTL (ITEM_CODE, FTA_CODE, SALES_NO, SALES_SEQ, PRODUCT_CODE, DIVISION_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, HS_CODE, REQUIREMENT_QTY, INPUT_AMOUNT, INAREA_QTY, INAREA_AMOUNT, OUTAREA_QTY, OUTAREA_AMOUNT, HS_CODE_YN, PRICE_NOTE, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY) VALUES
(#{row.itemCode}, #{row.ftaCode}, #{row.salesNo}, #{row.salesSeq}, #{row.productCode}, #{row.divisionCode}, #{row.companyCode}, #{row.hsCode}, #{row.requirementQty}, #{row.inputAmount}, #{row.originatingQty}, #{row.originatingAmount}, #{row.nonOriginatingQty}, #{row.nonOriginatingAmount}, #{row.hsCodeYn}, #{row.priceNote}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'CREATE_FCR', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'CREATE_FCR')
mapper.update: MERGE INTO FCR_MST FM USING (SELECT FM.FTA_CODE ,FM.SALES_NO ,FM.SALES_SEQ ,FM.DIVISION_CODE ,FM.COMPANY_CODE ,(SELECT ECD.RULE_CODE FROM PO_LEDGER PL INNER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_MST ECM ON ECM.COMPANY_CODE = PL.COMPANY_CODE AND ECM.VENDOR_CODE = PL.VENDOR_CODE AND ECM.SUBMIT_STATUS = '4' AND ((ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'C' AND PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE BETWEEN ECM.APPLY_DATE AND ECM.END_DATE) OR (ECM.COO_CERTIFY_TYPE = 'N' AND PL.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO)) LEFT OUTER JOIN EXT_COO_CERTIFY_DTL ECD ON ECD.COO_CERTIFY_NO = ECM.COO_CERTIFY_NO AND ECD.VENDOR_CODE = ECM.VENDOR_CODE AND ECD.DIVISION_CODE = ECM.DIVISION_CODE AND ECD.COMPANY_CODE = ECM.COMPANY_CODE AND ECD.ITEM_CODE = PL.ITEM_CODE AND #{invoiceDate} BETWEEN ECD.APPLY_DATE AND ECD.END_DATE WHERE PL.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND PL.ITEM_CODE = COALESCE(IM.ITEM_CODE_ANOTHER, FM.PRODUCT_CODE) AND ECD.FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE ORDER BY PL.WAREHOUSING_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AS VENDOR_RULE_CONTENTS ,(SELECT RULE_CONTENTS FROM FTA_RULE FR WHERE FR.HS_CODE = SUBSTRING(FM.HS_CODE FROM 1 FOR LENGTH(FR.HS_CODE)) AND FR.FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND HS_CODE_SUB_CATEGORY = 1 FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AS RULE_CONTENTS ,CASE WHEN FD.OUTAREA_QTY = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS COO_YN FROM FCR_MST FM INNER JOIN FCR_DTL FD ON FD.FTA_CODE = FM.FTA_CODE AND FD.SALES_NO = FM.SALES_NO AND FD.SALES_SEQ = FM.SALES_SEQ AND FD.DIVISION_CODE = FM.DIVISION_CODE AND FD.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN ITEM_MST IM ON IM.ITEM_CODE = FM.PRODUCT_CODE AND IM.COMPANY_CODE = FM.COMPANY_CODE WHERE FM.PRODUCT_ASSETS_TYPE IN ('M', 'R', 'B') AND FM.SALES_NO = #{salesNo} AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = #{divisionCode} AND FM.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode}) SUB ON (FM.FTA_CODE = SUB.FTA_CODE AND FM.SALES_NO = SUB.SALES_NO AND FM.SALES_SEQ = SUB.SALES_SEQ AND FM.DIVISION_CODE = SUB.DIVISION_CODE AND FM.COMPANY_CODE = SUB.COMPANY_CODE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET FM.FTA_COO_YN = SUB.COO_YN ,FM.COMPANY_COO_YN = SUB.COO_YN ,FM.RULE_CONTENTS = COALESCE(SUB.VENDOR_RULE_CONTENTS, SUB.RULE_CONTENTS)
